recent_posts.title: Debian -- News -- Updated Debian 13: 13.4 released
recent_posts.summary: Debian 13.4 (codename Trixie) point release is now available, incorporating updates to numerous packages. Key highlights include a glibc update fixing heap corruption (CVE-2026-0861), stack leak (CVE-2026-0915), and uninitialized memory use (CVE-2025-15281); openssh fixes for possible code execution (CVE-2025-61984, CVE-2025-61985); MariaDB and PostgreSQL 17 upstream stable releases with security fixes; dpkg denial of service fix (CVE-2026-2219); suricata denial/overflow fixes; and dozens of other CVE patches across packages including apache2, erlang, glibc, libpng1.6, qemu, samba, sqlite3, wget2, wireshark, xen, and zabbix. Many packages were also rebuilt against the updated glibc.

recent_posts.title: Debian -- News -- Updated Debian 13: 13.3 released
recent_posts.summary: Debian 13.3 point release includes security fixes and bug patches across 100+ packages. Major updates address CVEs in Apache, glibc, PostgreSQL, QEMU, and numerous other core system components. The release includes Linux kernel 6.12.63, updated Intel microcode, and fixes for container runtimes (Docker, Podman, LXC). Security patches cover vulnerabilities ranging from buffer overflows and SQL injection to timing attacks and privilege escalation issues.

recent_posts.title: Debian -- News -- Updated Debian 12: 12.13 released
recent_posts.summary: Debian 12.13 point release addresses numerous security vulnerabilities across system packages. Major updates include fixes for Apache HTTP Server (integer overflow, environment variable parsing), Git (arbitrary file operations), PostgreSQL (privilege escalation), and the Linux kernel. The release patches CVEs in widely-used libraries like glib2.0, libssh, OpenSSL, and ImageMagick, while updating Intel microcode and NVIDIA drivers. Multiple packages were rebuilt against updated glibc and containerd versions.

recent_posts.title: Debian -- News -- Updated Debian 13: 13.2 released
recent_posts.summary: Debian 13.2 point release includes updates to 150+ packages with security fixes, bug corrections, and compatibility improvements. Notable updates include Linux kernel 6.12.57, OpenSSL stable release, systemd improvements, and patches for multiple CVEs across curl, samba, libssh, and other core system components. The release addresses critical vulnerabilities, fixes hardware support issues, and updates various desktop applications and server tools.

recent_posts.title: Debian -- News -- Updated Debian 12: 12.12 released
recent_posts.summary: Debian 12.12 point release includes security fixes and package updates for over 100 components. Major updates include Apache2 security patches addressing multiple CVEs, glibc fixes for memory management issues, Linux kernel updates with ABI changes, and numerous library security fixes. The release also includes rebuilds against updated glibc and various bug fixes across system components.

recent_posts.title: Debian -- News -- Updated Debian 13: 13.1 released
recent_posts.summary: Debian 13.1 point release is now available, bringing security fixes and bug corrections to the stable distribution. The update includes patches for multiple packages including ImageMagick, Git, GNOME components, and various system tools. Users can upgrade existing installations through standard package managers without needing new installation media.

recent_posts.title: Debian -- News -- Debian 13 "trixie" released
recent_posts.summary: Debian 13 'trixie' has been released after over 2 years of development, featuring updated desktop environments including GNOME 48 and KDE Plasma 6.3. The release includes over 69,830 packages with significant updates to core software like Linux kernel 6.12 LTS, Python 3.13, and PostgreSQL 17. For the first time, it officially supports the riscv64 architecture while dropping support for i386 as a regular architecture. The distribution offers 5 years of support and is available across multiple cloud platforms and installation methods.

recent_posts.title: Debian -- News -- Updated Debian 12: 12.11 released
recent_posts.summary: Debian has released an update for its stable distribution, Debian 12, with version 12.11, known as 'bookworm'. This point release addresses security issues and fixes serious problems but does not constitute a new version. Users who frequently update through security.debian.org won't need many additional package updates. New installation images will be available soon. A known issue with the Linux kernel affects the watchdog and w83977f_wdt modules on the amd64 architecture, which will be fixed in a future update.

recent_posts.title: Debian -- News -- Updated Debian 12: 12.10 released
recent_posts.summary: Debian 12 (bookworm) has released its tenth update (12.10), focusing on security fixes and serious bug corrections. This point release does not constitute a new version but updates some included packages. Frequent security updates from security.debian.org will have already addressed most changes. New installation images will be available soon, and users can upgrade their existing installations using Debian's HTTP mirrors.

recent_posts.title: Debian -- News -- The Debian Project mourns the loss of Steve Langasek (vorlon)
recent_posts.summary: Steve Langasek, a dedicated contributor and developer within the Debian and Ubuntu communities, has passed away at the age of 45. Known for his technical excellence and deep commitment to Free Software, Steve played a crucial role in the development of tools and release processes for Debian. He was also a respected mentor and advocate for the social aspects of Free Software development. His legacy includes significant contributions to Samba, PAM, and LDAP, and his influence extended to numerous developers and projects globally.

top_posts.title: Debian -- News -- Updated Debian 10: 10.13 released
top_posts.summary: The latest version of the OpenSSL 1.1.1e version is now available in a new version. This point release mainly adds corrections for security issues, along with a few adjustments for serious problems. New installation images will be available soon at the regular locations. The new version also includes a new set of software that uses expired certificates and the latest version [CVE-2022-28181 CVE-2024-28185.

top_posts.title: Debian -- News -- Updated Debian 12: 12.8 released
top_posts.summary: Debian 12.8 has been released, bringing security fixes and corrections for serious problems. Users who regularly update from security.debian.org will have fewer packages to update. The new release is not a full new version, but it updates packages. New installation images will be available soon, and existing installations can be upgraded from Debian mirrors.

top_posts.title: Debian -- News -- Updated Debian 11: 11.5 released
top_posts.summary: New installation images will be available soon at the regular locations. Fix several overflows in wide character functions; add a few EVEX optimized string functions to fix a performance issue. Make grantpt usable after multi-threaded fork; ensure that libio vtable protection is enabled. The Security Team has already released an advisory for each of these updates.

top_posts.title: Debian -- News -- Updated Debian 11: 11.9 released
top_posts.summary: Debian has released an update (version 11.9) for its oldstable distribution, which includes security corrections and bug fixes. Existing installations can be upgraded using an up-to-date Debian mirror.

top_posts.title: Debian -- News -- Debian 12.4 to supersede Debian 12.3
top_posts.summary: Debian 12.4 will supersede Debian 12.3 due to file system corruption issues with linux-image-6.1.0-14*. The release team halted the release and took immediate measures to address the issues. For further information, visit the Debian web pages.
